diagnostics: Tutorial instructions precede the mainland Fate-Locked run. No tutorial action grants a mainland permission.

text: Choose your appearance and experience level. Speak to the Gielinor Guide, open Settings, then speak again.
Leave east. Follow the Survival Expert’s prompts: view your inventory, net shrimp, view Skills, chop a tree, light logs and cook shrimp.
Visit the chef west of the pond. Mix the supplied flour and water; cook the dough on the range.
Follow the path to the Quest Guide. Open the Quest List and finish the conversation.
Descend the ladder. Follow the Mining Instructor: mine tin and copper, smelt bronze, then smith a dagger.
Visit the Combat Instructor. Inspect equipment, equip the supplied weapons and shield, then complete the melee and ranged rat lessons.
Climb upstairs. Use the bank and poll booth; speak to the Account Guide and open Account Management.
Visit Brother Brace and complete the Prayer interface lesson.
Follow the Magic Instructor’s spellbook and Wind Strike lesson. Before leaving, speak to the Ironman tutor to choose Ironman restrictions. Then follow the Lumbridge teleport instructions.

diagnostics: Boss tactics, equipment permissions and individual God Wars wing entry requirements are not an automatically verified route.

text: After Desert Treasure I, receive and read the messenger’s important letter. Prepare legal equipment and supplies for all four God Wars Dungeon wings. The overview lists the level requirements; individual doors and boss rooms have further entry requirements.

Obtain the Armadyl, Bandos, Saradomin and Zamorak pieces from their respective generals. A general’s piece requires the highest damage contribution. Their bodyguards can also drop the corresponding piece, at a lower rate. Keep all four distinct pieces.

With all four pieces in your inventory, assemble the frozen key. Open the frozen door on the south side of the dungeon’s main chamber. Speak to Ashuelot Reis inside and finish her explanation to complete the miniquest. Defeating Nex is not required.

diagnostics: Raid puzzles, encounters and equipment permissions require the Tombs of Amascut strategy guide; this is the miniquest sequence.

text: After Beneath Cursed Sands, visit Osmumten’s tomb at the Necropolis and speak to Maisa. Enter the pyramid, watch the scene and receive her journal. Prepare for a complete Tombs of Amascut raid using equipment and access permitted by your run.

Complete the four paths and defeat Akkha, Ba-Ba, Kephri and Zebak to free the lesser gods. Continue downstairs and finish the Wardens encounter. Use the dedicated raid strategy guide for the puzzles and combat mechanics.
After the victory sequence and rewards, return to the lobby. Speak to Maisa again to finish the miniquest and receive the lamp. Guide navigation does not record a raid victory or award quest rewards.
